known_scientific_limitations: Scenario future actions remain an optimistic approximation rather than a fully nonanticipative multistage tree.
Fixed solver time budgets, feasible MIP incumbents and nonsmooth local refinement do not establish global annual-cost optimality.
The2025 year has been used for development; it is not an untouched test set.
One formal tree-model seed is available; no sample standard deviation can be estimated.
Battery intensity measures are proxies, not a calibrated lifespan/degradation model.
